svg.title: ChromaQuant. Learn a color palette with K-means, compare it with uniform RGB, and download an indexed PNG. On the 16-color demo, K-means achieved 35.85 dB PSNR.
svg.desc: ChromaQuant. Learn a color palette with K-means, compare it with uniform RGB, and download an indexed PNG. On the 16-color demo, K-means achieved 35.85 dB PSNR.

g.text: Learn a palette from the colors in your image.
Compare K-means with a uniform RGB palette,
inspect the difference in a split preview,
and download the result as an indexed PNG.
Measured on the Afterglow demo. Uniform RGB scored 17.41 dB
